claim_boundary: This protocol tests the frozen E0 machine-first layer on one prospectively enrolled held-out target. It does not establish canonical Unit003 semantics, population accuracy, prevalence, or general Kubernetes correctness.

defects: repository was materialized as kubernetes/kubernetes although the frozen candidate_id names kubernetes/kubectl
machine_driven_refinement contained one malformed JSON member without a value

stop_conditions: E0 emits a valid regression witness
E0 emits stable-in-declared-scope under all frozen obligations
E0 remains assurance-incomplete with no satisfiable machine-requested target-only refinement
machine_driven_refinement.trigger: Frozen E0 emits target-only PROBE_PLAN.json or REFINEMENT_REQUESTS.json.

first_round_algorithm.step_1: Resolve and record exact target commit and recursive Git tree identity.
first_round_algorithm.step_2: Enumerate target-revision repository paths without reading file contents.
first_round_algorithm.step_3: Score paths deterministically using only frozen lexical anchors derived before inspection from the screened operation: annotate, resource-version, resourceversion, resource_version, resourceVersion.
first_round_algorithm.step_4: Select the lexicographically tie-broken top bounded path set under the frozen path policy; fetch exact bytes for those paths only.
first_round_algorithm.step_5: Construct MACHINE_INPUT.json plus exact evidence-file SHA-256 closure; no semantic assertions, human gold, canonical verdict, witness, or ESTABLISHED relation may be inserted by acquisition.
first_round_algorithm.step_6: Run frozen E0 and seal the complete first-round semantic artifacts before human semantic adjudication of screened-operation evidence or prediction.

machine_first_acquisition.network_policy: Acquisition may use GitHub read-only retrieval of exact pinned target bytes; frozen semantic core remains network-free.

ranking: path contains command or cmd near annotate

machine_first_acquisition.source_authority: Exact committed bytes reachable from kubernetes/kubectl target_revision only.

preseal_incident_001.actual_response: GitHub commit endpoint also returned patches for go.mod and go.sum.
preseal_incident_001.effect_on_blindness: Strict zero-byte preseal blindness is no longer claimable; machine-first outcome independence remains protected by deterministic predeclared acquisition and immutable E0.
preseal_incident_001.request_intent: Resolve exact target commit existence and tree identity only.
